reasoning_content:
The dev server's .next directory got clobbered by the production build (bun run build). That's my fault for running build concurrently. Let me kill the dev server, clean .next, and restart dev.

Actually the dev server started before I ran build. The build corrupted .next. Let me restart cleanly.

action.command: cd /workspace && kill 673 705 785 2>/dev/null; sleep 3; pkill -f "next dev" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "start-server.js" 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; rm -rf .next; ps aux | grep "[n]ext" | wc -l
